text_block_list.text:
Passing in front of the dance studio,
I saw Narita Top Road dancing passionately.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—*Haa*, *haa*... That's not good enough at all...!
Not yet! One more time—!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Class Rep!
I finally found you~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh—what's the matter?
Why are you in such a panic...?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It's a huge emergency!
Please, come with me! Help everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! It sounds like a real crisis.
Understood, lead the way!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Okay! ...Ah! Trainer over there,
won't you come with us too, please?!
It'll be much more reassuring if an adult is there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Everyone! Are you alright!!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
C-Class Rep~~!! You came?!
And the Trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: *Phew*, now we might actually survive tomorrow's retake exam...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! I was in such a rush
that I forgot to explain the situation...
choice_data_list: And here I wondered what happened...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
B-Both of you!
Please help tutor us!
At this rate, we're totally doomed~!

I don't mind helping, but Narita Top Road
was supposed to be in the middle of dance practice.
Worried, I glanced over at her...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: He... hehe... ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. So no one was
in any real danger after all. What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If that's what it is, then it's no trouble at all.
I'll teach you thoroughly, so let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: A-As expected of our Class Rep~~! Thank you so much!!
choice_data_list: Are you sure about your own practice?
Are you sure about your own practice?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can practice dancing anytime.
More importantly, is your schedule alright, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I don't have any plans, so I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?! That would be wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's divide up the subjects.
First step: "Grasping the situation"—confirming the test scope!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next is "Task analysis."
Let's pinpoint exactly what you don't understand
and systematically eliminate those weak spots!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, fight on!
Let's make sure we score high marks!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~~!!

The next day, curious about the retake results,
I peeked into the classroom...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
We did it~! We passed~~!!
Thank you! You really saved us~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! Your explanations were super clear!
If our Class Rep hadn't been there, who knows what would've happened...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I only lent a hand.
You were able to pull through
because everyone worked so hard!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
For real, exactly that~! Top Road-san
is so aaamazing at studying, racing, AND dancing~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No, that's not...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Still, thank you!
If my efforts helped everyone out,
then that makes me truly happy!

Narita Top Road smiled refreshingly.
She truly was a dependable, wonderful honor student.
